Christina Koch will serve as NASA’s acting deputy chief engineer beginning November 1, 2026, after Katherine Van Hooser retires.
claims.source_title: NASA Names Astronaut Christina Koch Acting Deputy Chief Engineer
claims.supporting_quote: NASA engineer and astronaut Christina Koch will serve as the agency’s acting deputy chief engineer beginning on Sunday, Nov. 1, following the retirement of Katherine Van Hooser, who will conclude more than 35 years of distinguished service to the agency on Wednesday, Oct. 21.
